# claudette

> claudette is a Pythonic wrapper around Anthropic's Claude API that simplifies multi-turn conversations, tool use, and agentic workflows for Python developers, abstracting away low-level API details into a clean `Client` and `Chat` interface.

## Optional

- [Release notes](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/claudette/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): - Add Claude 4.6 models, web_fetch support (#109)
